(2) Paddles: Unity = small block-like orange shapes at mid height; approved = big copper-gold D-trays (upper left ~x 60-240 y 380-470, right ~x 720-860 y 480-590) plus smaller ones further in. (3) River: Unity's open water is about twice too wide at mid distance and the foam lies in wide FLAT white fields; approved = a narrow S ribbon with narrow, taller foam rims and the purple walls rising right behind them. (4) Walls: Unity shows radial streaks / spokes of dark slots; approved = neat concentric rows of small dark oval perforations with pink-white specular streaks. (5) Coins: Unity's visible coins bunch at mid distance right of centre; approved = a trail up the S-curve. (6) Benny is the closest area (benny visual 70.8); his round bottom is cut flat by the opaque water at y ~1175.

The drum meshes use DrumLayout05; BubbleField.WallHalfWidth (floating bubbles) and gameplay code use RiverPath. If you change the cross-section, keep the floating bubbles inside the tube and near the walls / foam like the approved image (minimal change in BubbleField.WallHalfWidth, reported in shared_changes) and keep RiverPath.ClampLateral steering sensible. (b) RBW_BankEdges (RainbowFoamBank.hlsl) and FoamBank.BankEdges (C#) must stay line-by-line identical; coins keep >= 1.25 m from the foam waterline (coin-line clamp in BankEdges); foam bubble size / height is scaled 0.62..1.45 by camera distance in RBW_FoamVertex. The splash agent's contact shadow behind Benny already exists: build on it, do not duplicate it.
